integrity: The all-sample-size proof uses the independent exponential spacing representation and exact Dirichlet moments. Finite exact computation is supplementary and does not establish the infinite quantifier.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas assume iid exponential sampling and ordinary order statistics.
A 2000 applied paper already displays the expected exponential median-to-mean curve for small samples, so those plotted expectation values are not asserted to be new numerical data.
The search cannot exclude an unindexed historical formula for normalized exponential order statistics.
title: Exact finite-sample moments of exponential quantile-to-mean ratios
